answer: To reach the reward summit, an attacker must fund many distinct identities, each paying the same stake plus registration cost, while a sparrow-sized farm of fake accounts gains nothing because rewards split across identities and slashing burns deposits on collusion. Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit and complete a unique proof-of-personhood attestation before joining. Like pruning an orchard, duplicate accounts are detected via graph analysis and removed, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From once0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
